description: Source code for disk cache backend I/O operations, including BackendIO and InFlightBackendIO classes, managing asynchronous disk cache operations on background threads.

classes.name: BackendIO
classes.description: Handles individual backend I/O operations, including initialization, opening, creating, reading, writing, and other cache management tasks, executing asynchronously on background threads.

classes.name: InFlightBackendIO
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent backend I/O operations, posting tasks to a background thread and handling their completion callbacks.

methods.name: LeakEntryImpl
methods.description: Leakes a strong reference to an EntryImpl, returning a raw pointer while managing reference counts.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Executes either an entry-specific or backend-specific operation based on the current operation type.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteBackendOperation
methods.description: Performs backend operations such as open, create, doom, and enumeration on a background thread.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteEntryOperation
methods.description: Performs entry-specific operations like read, write, sparse read/write, and range queries.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::Init
methods.description: Initializes a backend I/O operation and posts it to the background thread.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Posts an open or create entry operation.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::ReadData
methods.description: Posts a read data operation for an entry.
